name: PRE_WAR_PREPARATION
definition: Tempest fixes its order of battle and reorganises into two wings (V12 Ch2). Placement RECONSTRUCTED: only the narrative order (before V12 Ch4) is canonical.

name: IMPERIAL_DECISION_AND_MOBILIZATION
definition: Imperial council and war decree, legion taskings. That evening Rudra and Velgrynd hear that the Great March is decided (V12 Ch4, Epilogue).

name: APPROACH_MARCH
definition: The army leaves the capital 'the next day' (V12 Epilogue), masses at the border base (D-34), and advances slowly while Tempest holds its war council (the 'gathering', R0 = D-33). The border is crossed on D-5.

name: HALT_AND_DEPLOYMENT
definition: 'Soon after' the month mark the column halts. 700,000 infantry march into the forest and camp ~30 km from the capital.

name: FIRST_CONTACT_AND_SURFACE_BATTLE
definition: The Gazel call, Testarossa's ultimatum and its rejection, then the surface battle at the Dwargon gate front: Magitank Force and Flying Combat Corps destroyed in under two hours (~240,000 killed).

name: LABYRINTH_RAID
definition: Labyrinth Raider operation: 350,000 / 150,000 / 30,000 enter on days 1-3 (170,000 stay outside). Seven days elapsed at V13 Ch4. Minitz falls. More than 530,000 killed inside with no Tempest losses.

name: ANNIHILATION_OF_THE_OUTSIDE_CAMP
definition: After dawn Caligulio learns the labyrinth troops are dead. Carrera's Gravity Collapse, Geld's Second Corps and Diablo destroy the ~170,000 outside. Caligulio killed. Jura army: 940,000 killed.

name: RESURRECTION_AND_CONSOLIDATION
definition: Resurrection of ~700,000 (D+11), held as prisoners. Rewards and evolution (D+12). Prisoners calm (D+13). Yuuki prepares the coup. Rimuru arranges the meeting with Yuuki.

name: LONG_NIGHT
definition: The single long night from the evening of D+15 to the early hours of D+16: Miranda killed and the coup crushed in Tidu. Velgrynd destroys the 60,000 at Isthmus. Dwargon eastern front. Rimuru's party trapped. Dragon battle and Veldora's domination. Magic Beast Division destroyed. Flagship battles. Michael and Feldway withdraw. Includes the D+18 daytime planning.

name: POST_WAR_INTERVAL
definition: Officers take a day off. The capital returns to the surface. Rimuru interviews his subordinates. No fighting.

name: SUMMIT_AND_SETTLEMENT
definition: Three-nation summit: end-of-war agreement, Masayuki to be named emperor by Velgrynd, no war-crimes trials, prisoners to be released, reconstruction, Testarossa to open an embassy. Zamdo restored at the lunch break. Gazel leaves the next morning.

name: REPATRIATION_PREPARATION
definition: Caligulio prepares to march the resurrected prisoners home. Preparations done within a week and the departure follows (D+26 RECONSTRUCTED).
